Questions,
answered directly.

The practical details about privacy, formats, access, and what the Pro plan adds.

Is this background remover really free?

Yes. The Free plan removes backgrounds from 150 images per month at no cost, with no signup required.

Are my images uploaded to a server?

No. The planned tool processes images on your device, inside your browser, so your original files do not need to leave your device.

Does it work on phones and tablets?

Yes. The interface is designed for modern mobile, tablet, and desktop browsers.

What image formats are supported?

The planned launch supports JPG, PNG, and WebP images, with transparent PNG output.

What is included in Pro?

Pro is planned at $5 per month and adds batches of 500 or more images, priority processing, and reusable background templates.

Do I need to create an account?

No account is required for the Free plan. Open the tool, choose an image, and remove its background.
